name: skillz
description: Skillz marketplace (Codex): full bundle plus per-skill and grouped plugin entries.

plugins.name: skillz
plugins.description: Full bundle: every skill in the catalog (work-on-pr, review-pr-loop, continuous-learning, cmux-search, cmux-agent-tabs, gh-git-heredoc-body-file, claude-code-static-allow-bypasses-hook, python-ast-static-analyzer-scoping, wordpress-com-publish, git-add-u-rename-pitfall, git-branch-cleanup-script-races, git-graft-worktree-onto-remote, multi-phase-feature-pr-worktrees, gist-to-repo-migration, vercel-token-deploy-branch-domains, s3-presigned-upload-fails-nonexistent-bucket, neon-vercel-db-identify-and-migrate, gh-api-f-vs-F-body-file, gh-api-jq-no-arg, gh-fork-issues-disabled, gh-pr-graphql-401-rest-fallback, gh-pr-merge-delete-branch-closes-dependent-pr, gh-workflow-run-matching, github-api-list-endpoint-staleness-fresh-pr, github-closing-keywords-default-branch-only, github-private-repo-readme-image-rendering, claude-code-claudemd-symlink-write-refused, claude-code-codex-plugin-parity, claude-code-piebald-lsp-binary-on-path, claude-code-plugin-from-existing-repo, claude-code-plugin-python-bootstrap, claude-code-plugin-update-flow, claude-json-mcp-migration-slice, macos-bash-3.2-compat, emacs-batch-package-verify-pitfalls, python-symtable-no-col-offset-pairing, playwright-mcp-upload-hidden-file-input).

plugins.name: pr-loop
plugins.description: Paired PR-loop skills: work-on-pr (author) and review-pr-loop (reviewer).

plugins.name: work-on-pr
plugins.description: Author-side PR iteration loop only.

plugins.name: review-pr-loop
plugins.description: Reviewer-side PR iteration loop only.

plugins.name: cmux-search
plugins.description: Search all open cmux workspaces/tabs/panes (live scrollback + agent transcripts).

plugins.name: cmux-agent-tabs
plugins.description: Make AI agents show as watchable cmux tabs; Claude needs the claude-teams wrapper, Codex via codex-teams/hooks.

plugins.name: gh-git-heredoc-body-file
plugins.description: Body-file pattern: stop gh CLI and git mangling multi-line bodies with backticks, code blocks, or $(...).

plugins.name: claude-code-static-allow-bypasses-hook
plugins.description: Why a Claude Code PreToolUse hook never fires for some commands: static permissions.allow Bash globs short-circuit it.

plugins.name: python-ast-static-analyzer-scoping
plugins.description: Build a Python ast analyzer: import-alias resolution plus module-load vs deferred execution scoping.

plugins.name: wordpress-com-publish
plugins.description: Acquire a WordPress.com OAuth2 token (authorization-code flow) and publish/update posts via public-api.wordpress.com.

plugins.name: git-add-u-rename-pitfall
plugins.description: git add -u can miss a rename, leaving the old path staged as deleted; stage the new path explicitly.

plugins.name: git-branch-cleanup-script-races
plugins.description: Branch-cleanup scripts race against concurrent ref updates; snapshot refs before deleting.

plugins.name: git-graft-worktree-onto-remote
plugins.description: Graft a local worktree's commits onto a remote branch without re-cloning.

plugins.name: multi-phase-feature-pr-worktrees
plugins.description: Run a multi-phase feature as stacked worktree PRs so each phase reviews independently.

plugins.name: gist-to-repo-migration
plugins.description: Migrate a gist's full revision history into a real git repo, preserving commits.

plugins.name: vercel-token-deploy-branch-domains
plugins.description: Token-only per-branch Vercel deploys to fixed custom domains; gitBranch domain pin; preview custom-domain SSO 401.

plugins.name: s3-presigned-upload-fails-nonexistent-bucket
plugins.description: Presigned S3 upload fails because the bucket is wrong/missing; HeadBucket 404-vs-403; CloudFront origin reveals real bucket.

plugins.name: neon-vercel-db-identify-and-migrate
plugins.description: Identify which Neon project backs a Vercel app and migrate/split it; pg_dump>=server; safe non-destructive cutover.

plugins.name: gh-api-f-vs-F-body-file
plugins.description: gh api -F (uppercase) reads @file into the field; -f sends the value as a literal string.

plugins.name: gh-api-jq-no-arg
plugins.description: gh api --jq needs its filter as the argument; a misplaced/empty --jq silently drops the filter.

plugins.name: gh-fork-issues-disabled
plugins.description: gh issue create fails on a fork because GitHub disables the Issues tab on forks by default.

plugins.name: gh-pr-graphql-401-rest-fallback
plugins.description: When gh PR GraphQL calls return 401, fall back to the REST PR endpoints.

plugins.name: gh-pr-merge-delete-branch-closes-dependent-pr
plugins.description: Deleting the branch on gh pr merge can auto-close a dependent PR stacked on it.

plugins.name: gh-workflow-run-matching
plugins.description: Match a gh workflow run to its trigger when multiple runs share one workflow name.

plugins.name: github-api-list-endpoint-staleness-fresh-pr
plugins.description: GitHub list endpoints serve stale empty results on a fresh PR; use the timeline / single-resource fetch.

plugins.name: github-closing-keywords-default-branch-only
plugins.description: GitHub closing keywords (Closes #N) only auto-close when the PR merges into the default branch.

plugins.name: github-private-repo-readme-image-rendering
plugins.description: Images in a private-repo README need authenticated or relative paths to render.

plugins.name: claude-code-claudemd-symlink-write-refused
plugins.description: Fix Edit/Write 'Refusing to write through symlink' on ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md by resolving the symlink to its real target path.

plugins.name: claude-code-codex-plugin-parity
plugins.description: Port a Claude Code plugin to the Codex CLI (or back); where the two plugin systems match vs diverge, and the shared hooks.json caveats.

plugins.name: claude-code-piebald-lsp-binary-on-path
plugins.description: Piebald LSP plugins surface the LSP tool but the language-server binary isn't on PATH; install and expose the server binary.

plugins.name: claude-code-plugin-from-existing-repo
plugins.description: Convert a repo that ships Claude Code commands/hooks (manual copy-in) into an installable plugin without breaking manual install.

plugins.name: claude-code-plugin-python-bootstrap
plugins.description: Bootstrap Python deps from a Claude Code plugin hook so /plugin install is one-click on systems lacking them (PEP 668-safe).

plugins.name: claude-code-plugin-update-flow
plugins.description: Update an installed Claude Code plugin via /plugin marketplace update + /reload-plugins, not the discovery-picker /plugin update.

plugins.name: claude-json-mcp-migration-slice
plugins.description: Identify the exact ~/.claude.json slice that carries MCP config for cross-machine migration vs session bookkeeping.

plugins.name: macos-bash-3.2-compat
plugins.description: Fix bash scripts that fail on macOS's stock bash 3.2 (declare -A, mapfile, and other bash-4-only constructs).

plugins.name: emacs-batch-package-verify-pitfalls
plugins.description: Avoid false-negative failures when verifying an Emacs package install with emacs --batch (no ELPA auto-activation on load-path; use-package deferred loading skips :config).

plugins.name: python-symtable-no-col-offset-pairing
plugins.description: Pair Python symtable scope entries with AST nodes when symtable exposes no col_offset, via (lineno, name) grouping.

plugins.name: playwright-mcp-upload-hidden-file-input
plugins.description: Playwright MCP: attach a file to a hidden <input type=file> (unhide+tag via evaluate, upload by id, verify via CDN/S3 URL).

plugins.name: slack-xoxc-session-client
plugins.description: Drive the Slack web API as yourself via a live browser session (xoxc token + httpOnly d cookie) when you cannot install a Slack app. Ships a runnable Python client.

plugins.name: continuous-learning
plugins.description: Codex-only: continuous-learning skill (no hooks). For the hook-driven bundle, install codex-continuous-learning.

plugins.name: codex-continuous-learning
plugins.description: Codex-only: continuous-learning skill plus UserPromptSubmit + Stop hooks.

plugins.name: agent-team-orchestration
plugins.description: Run a team of agents over a repo's open issues: architect plans the parallel set, per-issue squads (dev + adversarial reviewer + SDET + productivity engineer), each a watchable cmux tab.
